short_description: Deutsche Bahn AG (DB) is the Berlin-headquartered German national railway company, 100% owned by the Federal Republic of Germany, organised as a joint-stock company (Aktiengesellschaft) under private law, and the operator of the country's principal long-distance passenger rail services (ICE and IC/EC), a large regional-rail franchise portfolio, and a heavy-rail freight and infrastructure business; it is the incumbent long-distance rail operator against which the open-access competitor FlixTrain (the rail subsidiary of Flix SE) has competed since 2018.
